# North weekly (Ilse covering)

**2026-02-09**  
Compiled from Ilse Varga’s team-lead notes for Ruth Calloway.

## Coverage during Dana’s leave

- Ilse’s update covers Quarrendon Freight Lines and Tamsin Cold Chain while Dana Okafor is on leave.
- Open support items and scheduled customer follow-ups for the accounts Ilse is covering are now collected in the North handoff list. Ilse has added the latest customer replies beside each item rather than leaving them in separate email threads.
- This week’s immediate work is appointment visibility, shift handoffs, and checking that saved reports match what dispatch teams see in Pemberline Dock.

## Quarrendon Freight Lines

- Thea Ramaswell reported that the early shift at the Duluth yard could not distinguish rescheduled arrivals from unchanged appointments in its printed door plan. Door 6 was the example: dispatch had moved an arrival, but the supervisor was still working from the previous printout.
- Ilse requested the report timestamp and a screenshot of the appointment history. Support ticket NORTH-241 records both examples.
- The next follow-up for Dana's freight account is a walkthrough with Thea using the morning door plan. Ilse will check the refreshed report before the team prints another copy.

## Tamsin Cold Chain

- The freezer receiving team flagged two appointments appearing under the same trailer reference in its afternoon queue. Ilse asked the shift coordinator to preserve both records until support checks the edit history.
- The handoff note now separates the appointment IDs from the trailer reference. This should make the next customer reply easier to follow.

## Equipment and next actions

- IT is reimaging Dana's laptop while she is out. The device is with the service desk.
- Ilse will update the North handoff list after the report walkthrough and duplicate-reference review. Remaining customer replies will be included in the next weekly.
